size.value: Colour photo, 35mm x 45mm, per ICAO criteria

head_height.value: Face height (chin to crown) must be 32-36mm, corresponding to 70-80% of the photo (per the ICAO-criteria standard the visa page requires)

background.value: One colour and bright (ideally neutral grey), contrasting with face and hair, no pattern, no shadows (per the ICAO-criteria standard the visa page requires)

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, looking directly into the camera; head neither at an angle nor turned (per the ICAO-criteria standard the visa page requires)

glasses_policy.value: Eyes must be clearly recognisable; reflections, tinted glasses or sunglasses not permitted; frame may not cover the eyes (per the ICAO-criteria standard the visa page requires)

headwear_policy.value: Headwear generally not permitted; exceptions possible for religious reasons, face visible from chin to forehead with no shadows (per the ICAO-criteria standard the visa page requires)

expression.en: The expression should be neutral with the mouth closed, looking directly into the camera; the head should be neither at an angle nor turned.
expression.ko: 표정은 중립적이어야 하며 입을 다물고 카메라를 정면으로 응시해야 한다. 고개는 기울이거나 돌리지 않아야 한다.
expression.ja: 表情は中立でなければならず、口を閉じてカメラを正面から見つめること。頭を傾けたり回したりしてはならない。

glasses.en: Eyes must be clearly recognisable; reflections, tinted glasses, or sunglasses are not permitted, and the frame may not cover the eyes.
glasses.ko: 눈이 명확히 식별되어야 하며, 반사·색안경·선글라스는 허용되지 않고 안경테가 눈을 가려서는 안 된다.
glasses.ja: 目がはっきりと識別できなければならず、反射・色付きレンズ・サングラスは認められず、フレームが目を覆ってはならない。

headwear.en: Headwear is generally not permitted; exceptions are possible for religious reasons, in which case the face must be visible from the chin to the forehead with no shadows.
headwear.ko: 머리가리개(모자 등)는 원칙적으로 허용되지 않으나 종교적 사유로 예외가 인정될 수 있으며, 이 경우 턱 끝부터 이마까지 얼굴이 그림자 없이 보여야 한다.
headwear.ja: 頭部を覆うもの(帽子等)は原則として認められないが、宗教上の理由により例外が認められる場合があり、その際は顎先から額まで影なく顔が見えなければならない。

db_conflicts.research_value: "One colour and bright (ideally neutral grey)", per the ICAO-criteria standard incorporated by reference on Luxembourg's visa page -- the officially recommended background is neutral grey, not explicitly white

cross_verification.note_en: The Embassy of Luxembourg in New Delhi's official short-term Schengen visa page (newdelhi.mae.lu, part of the mae.lu diplomatic-mission domain family under the Ministry of Foreign and European Affairs) was directly fetched and confirms: 'Passport photo according to ICAO criteria in color with dimensions of 35x45 mm.' Since Luxembourg's own MAE explicitly defines 'ICAO criteria' via the ISO/ICAO photo guidelines PDF hosted at mae.gouvernement.lu (the same document verified for lu-passport in this batch), that PDF's detailed background/expression/glasses/headwear rules are extended here as the operative Luxembourg standard for visa photos too, since the visa page incorporates it by reference rather than stating a separate rule set. Fields not addressed in either document (validity/recency window, ears visibility, explicit clothing/accessories rules for visas) are left unverified.
cross_verification.note_ko: 주뉴델리 룩셈부르크 대사관 공식 페이지(newdelhi.mae.lu, 외교부 mae.lu 공관망 소속)에서 'ICAO 기준에 따른 컬러 사진, 35x45mm' 요건을 직접 확인함. 룩셈부르크 외교부가 'ICAO 기준'을 정의하는 문서(mae.gouvernement.lu 소재 ISO/ICAO 사진 가이드라인 PDF, lu-passport 항목과 동일 문서)를 그대로 원용하는 구조이므로, 세부 배경·표정·안경·머리가리개 규정은 해당 PDF를 근거로 확장 적용함.
